# Rusted Cube

> A voxel sandbox running in the browser. Terrain generation, game loop, player
> physics, collision, block raycasting and mesh building are written in Rust and
> compiled to WebAssembly. Rendering talks to WebGL2 directly, no 3D engine.

Click to grab the cursor. WASD to move, space to jump, shift to sprint,
left click to break, right click to place what you're holding, R for a new
world. The block you're aiming at is outlined.

On a touchscreen, the left analog stick walks, the right stick turns the camera,
dragging anywhere above the sticks also looks around, and the action buttons
jump, break and place.

Things worth knowing:

- The world is a 7x7 window of 16x48x16 chunks following the player. Chunks
  outside it get unloaded, edits are stored per chunk and replayed on return.
- Meshing is greedy and per chunk, with per-vertex AO and vertical skylight
  baked in. Two packed u32 per vertex, one shared index buffer, frustum culled.
- Day/night cycle drives the sun and sky color, but there is no shadow mapping.
- LAN multiplayer needs the bundled server in server/, which has no
  dependencies. The GitHub Pages build is static, so single player only.
- Touch controls and a lower mobile render scale keep the game playable on phones.
- Builds on Rust 1.67. CI pins 1.76 because 1.82 changed the wasm ABI.

## Source

- [README](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/README.md):
  build instructions, controls, technical notes
- [world.rs](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/src/world.rs):
  chunks, terrain and trees, lighting, DDA raycast, greedy meshing
- [renderer.rs](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/src/renderer.rs):
  WebGL2 renderer, frustum culling, shaders, avatars, block outline
- [game.rs](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/src/game.rs):
  browser events, frame loop, per-frame meshing budget
- [player.rs](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/src/player.rs):
  camera, movement, collision
- [perlin.rs](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/src/perlin.rs):
  seeded 2D perlin and ridged noise

## Multiplayer

- [protocol.rs](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/src/protocol.rs):
  wire format, JSON encoded and parsed by hand, shared with the server
- [net.rs](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/src/net.rs):
  websocket client, optional
- [server/src/main.rs](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/server/src/main.rs):
  static files, connection threads, world state
- [server/src/websocket.rs](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/server/src/websocket.rs):
  handshake and frame codec on std

## Optional

- [LICENSE](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
- [website-RustedCube.yml](https://github.com/AntoinePoisson/Rusted-Cube/blob/main/.github/workflows/website-RustedCube.yml):
  builds, tests and publishes the site to GitHub Pages
